findings.summary: The free-shipping check compares subtotal_cents() (cents) against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD (50, whole dollars), so shipping is waived for nearly every order (any cart of 50 cents or more) instead of only for $50 or more.
The only non-empty-cart test uses a $120 order that ships free regardless of units, so the unit bug goes undetected; tests are needed below the threshold and exactly at the threshold.
